methodology_label: One fixed manual crosswalk; no inverse fit, sensitivity ensemble, or outcome tuning

transport.interpretation: Project access index anchored to official airport and seaport milestones; not a percentage of roads, ports, or airports restored.

housing.interpretation: Project shelter/habitability index anchored to official qualitative evidence; not a percentage of habitable homes.

food.interpretation: Equal mean of potable-water customer access and grocery/big-box store availability.

healthcare.interpretation: Equal mean of hospital operational availability and a disclosed health-center unavailable-data project estimate. No commensurable island-wide health-center operational series was found for the window, so the health-center component follows the nearest official hospital trajectory; it is not a measured health-center percentage.

public_services.interpretation: Equal mean of restored electricity and the FCC share of reporting cellular sites operational. FCC states that provider reporting can be incomplete; this is not population coverage.

interpolation.aggregate: weighted arithmetic mean of component curves, then equal arithmetic mean of five service curves

scenario.name: Hurricane Maria retrospective: Puerto Rico, 30 days
scenario.initial_services: Day-0 reconstructed services clipped independently to the Scenario contract [0.05, 0.95]
scenario.post_landfall_tape: 30 explicit no-shock days; Maria is represented only by the initial condition

disclosures: The reconstruction is a project-derived recovery index, not an official FEMA restoration percentage.
Project-estimate anchors fill gaps where no commensurable island-wide series exists.

No commensurable island-wide health-center operational series was found for the window; its explicitly marked project-estimate component follows the nearest official hospital trajectory and is not a measured health-center percentage.
Policy and heuristic trajectories are simulated alternatives and are not causal estimates of real Puerto Rico outcomes.
Inputs and source selections are frozen before either planner is loaded.
